question: I checked the die again: the damaged location was Head instead. The severe injury roll is still 8.

record.title: Severe head injuries
record.keywords: severe head injury injuries roll result concussion bleeding blind deaf intracranial hemorrhage decapitation
record.layout: Printed page 86 has severe-injury rules at left and a complete Head 1d10 table in the middle; Arms is a separate right-hand table.
record.summary: For a severe head injury, roll 1d10 on the Head table. Five bleeding tokens kill a survivor. If a permanent injury has reached its recording limit, gain one bleeding token instead.
notes: The Head table is separate from the Arms table on the same page. Result 8 is Concussion: gain one random disorder and one bleeding token.

effects: Head explosion: survivor dies. Other survivors lose 1 survival.
Intracranial hemorrhage: cannot use or gain survival; permanent, record once; gain 1 bleeding token.
Deaf: suffer -1 permanent evasion; permanent, record once; gain 1 bleeding token.
Blind: suffer -1 permanent accuracy; permanent, record twice. With two, suffer -4 permanent accuracy and retire at end of next hunt or settlement phase; gain 1 bleeding token.
Concussion: gain 1 random disorder and 1 bleeding token.
Shattered jaw: cannot consume or be affected by events requiring consumption; cannot encourage; permanent, record once; gain 1 bleeding token.
Destroyed tooth: with 3+ courage gain +2 insanity; otherwise be knocked down.

response.answer: Severe injury: Head: 8 is 8. Concussion: gain 1 random disorder and 1 bleeding token.
